title: NonStationaryBrachistochrone: reproducibility package for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes
description:
Symbolic derivations, numerical verification scripts, figure-generation code, laboratory design studies, and manuscript sources for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes. The repository supports the companion studies of the FLRW and Vaidya sectors and of the conformal Kerr (Thakurta-Kerr) sector.

1.7.3 - a Bakry-Emery identity for the Thakurta-Kerr selector. A small addition to 1.7.2, made while checking the answers to the first-round referee report of Paper II against the soliton literature it cites.

New check. paper2/verification/verify_weighted_soliton.wls computes the full Ricci tensor of Thakurta-Kerr, g = A(eta)^2 g_Kerr, and of its a = 0 case. With phi = 2 ln A and the m-Bakry-Emery tensor at m = 2 - n = -2, Ric + Hess phi - (1/m) dphi dphi = mu g, and the conformal-Killing selector satisfies (1/2) L_W g + Ric_phi^m = lambda g, with lambda = A'/A + mu. For a non-flat seed lambda is constant exactly when A = A0 exp(c eta), and then lambda = c. Along geodesics the weighted drift reproduces A'/A. The script includes a control that must fail (without the weight, Ric is not pure trace). 22 checks pass; a run is archived next to it.

Paper II. A new paragraph states this identity, distinguishes it from the conformal rescaling of the metric used in the cited soliton papers, and cites Bakry and Emery (1985) and Case (2012, 2013). It characterises the selector without deriving it. The same pass corrects two sentences: a Killing selector removes the geodesic drift of the rail charge, but a curved rail may still need acceleration orthogonal to it; and Ric(u,u) is described as the Ricci focusing term. The trivial-weight reading of the curvature operator is stated as a formal reduction. Paper I (v8) and Paper II (v7) cite this release and each other.

Unchanged. Every other script and result of 1.7.2. The provenance check regenerates the manifest and the adiabatic slopes identically; content digest 42ed5ab1779c5813.
